answer: Each Ember agent deposits a juniper‑backed token bond on a decentralized jetty contract; the bond is tied to a unique cryptographic proof of hardware attestation stored in an oasis ledger. When neighboring agents detect duplicate attestations, they collectively broadcast a fraud proof that triggers automatic slashing of the offender’s bond. The cost to launch a Sybil scales linearly with the number of forged identities, making mass attacks economically prohibitive.
